{
  "type_map": {},
  "constraints": [
    {
      "id": "R1",
      "category": "count_semantics",
      "alternatives": [
        "df['NUM_PKTS_UP_TO_128_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_128_TO_256_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_256_TO_512_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_512_TO_1024_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_1024_TO_1514_BYTES'] == df['IN_PKTS'] + df['OUT_PKTS']",
        "df['NUM_PKTS_UP_TO_128_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_128_TO_256_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_256_TO_512_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_512_TO_1024_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_1024_TO_1514_BYTES'] <= df['IN_PKTS'] + df['OUT_PKTS']"
      ],
      "features": [
        "NUM_PKTS_UP_TO_128_BYTES",
        "NUM_PKTS_128_TO_256_BYTES",
        "NUM_PKTS_256_TO_512_BYTES",
        "NUM_PKTS_512_TO_1024_BYTES",
        "NUM_PKTS_1024_TO_1514_BYTES",
        "IN_PKTS",
        "OUT_PKTS"
      ],
      "rationale": "The sum of packet counts across all IP size bins must equal the total number of packets if no packet exceeds 1514 bytes, otherwise it is a lower bound."
    },
    {
      "id": "R2",
      "category": "count_semantics",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES'] <= df['IN_BYTES']) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS'] <= df['IN_PKTS']) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES'] <= df['OUT_BYTES']) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS'] <= df['OUT_PKTS'])"
      ],
      "features": [
        "RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES",
        "IN_BYTES",
        "RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS",
        "IN_PKTS",
        "RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES",
        "OUT_BYTES",
        "RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS",
        "OUT_PKTS"
      ],
      "rationale": "Retransmitted bytes and packets in each direction are a subset of the total bytes and packets sent in that direction."
    },
    {
      "id": "R3",
      "category": "count_semantics",
      "alternatives": [
        "df['TCP_FLAGS'] == (df['CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS'] | df['SERVER_TCP_FLAGS'])",
        "(df['TCP_FLAGS'] >= df['CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS']) & (df['TCP_FLAGS'] >= df['SERVER_TCP_FLAGS'])"
      ],
      "features": [
        "TCP_FLAGS",
        "CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS",
        "SERVER_TCP_FLAGS"
      ],
      "rationale": "The cumulative TCP flags of the whole flow should be the bitwise OR of the client and server directional cumulative flags, and at least as large as each directional set."
    },
    {
      "id": "R4",
      "category": "count_semantics",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['SHORTEST_FLOW_PKT'] == df['MIN_IP_PKT_LEN']) & (df['LONGEST_FLOW_PKT'] == df['MAX_IP_PKT_LEN'])"
      ],
      "features": [
        "SHORTEST_FLOW_PKT",
        "MIN_IP_PKT_LEN",
        "LONGEST_FLOW_PKT",
        "MAX_IP_PKT_LEN"
      ],
      "rationale": "The shortest/longest flow packet recorded under two different names must be identical because both describe the same IP packet length extremes."
    }
  ]
}
